description: Well-formed v0.1 queries (SCHEMA.md §5) that both parsers MUST accept: bare match, labels, one directed hop (out and in, with/without edge var), case-insensitive keywords, boolean WHERE with precedence and parentheses, IS [NOT] NULL, negative/bool/param operands, projection lists, ORDER BY ASC/DESC, LIMIT.

cases.query: MATCH (a:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(b:User) WHERE a.age >= $min AND NOT b.name IS NULL RETURN a.name, b.name ORDER BY a.age DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (a) WHERE a.x = 1 OR (a.y < 2 AND a.z <> 3) RETURN a
match (a) where a.x is not null return a.x
MATCH (a) RETURN a ORDER BY a.name ASC
MATCH (a) WHERE a.score >= -5 AND a.k = true RETURN a
MATCH (a) WHERE $threshold < a.v RETURN a, a.b, a.c
